definitions.explanation: A negative consequence imposed for wrongdoing or breaking rules.

examples.japanese: {罰|ばつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
{罰|ばつ}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦させられた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: As punishment, I was made to clean.
examples.notes: {罰|ばつ}が{当|あ}たる suggests divine or karmic punishment.

examples.japanese: ⟦ルール→ルール：00354_ruuru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{破|やぶ}った→破る：02321_yaburu⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧{罰|ばつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{与|あた}えられた→与える：01821_ataeru⟧。
examples.english: A severe penalty was imposed on the player who broke the rules.

notes:
COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {罰|ばつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to receive punishment
- {罰|ばつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}える→与える：01821_ataeru⟧: to give punishment
- ⟦{罰金|ばっきん}→罰金：18767_bakkin⟧: fine (monetary penalty)
- {罰|ばつ}⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧: penalty game (in game shows)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{刑罰|けいばつ}→刑罰：20566_keibatsu⟧: criminal punishment
- ⟦{処罰|しょばつ}→処罰：21006_shobatsu⟧: punishment, penalty (formal)

WATCH OUT:
Punishment by heaven or fate is usually read ばち: {罰|ばち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{当|あ}たる→当たる：01860_ataru⟧ (you'll be punished for that), ⟦{罰当|ばちあ}たり→罰当たり：15475_bachiatari⟧ (a person who deserves divine punishment).
